name: SK Notice Hider
author: Samarjit Kashyp

sections.description:
SK Notice Hider is a professional WordPress plugin that allows you to control and manage various types of notifications in your WordPress dashboard. Clean up your admin area by hiding unnecessary notices and emails while preserving critical security alerts.

Features

  • Hide update notification emails for plugins, themes, and core
  • Hide admin notices and warnings from dashboard
  • Hide plugin update and activation notices
  • Hide theme update and activation notices
  • Preserve critical security and error notices
  • Easy-to-use settings interface with sidebar layout
  • Fully compatible with WordPress 5.8+
  • Translation ready
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sk-notice-hider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > SK Notice Hider to configure the plugin
  4. Check the notification types you want to hide and save settings
sections.faq:
Will this hide critical security notices?

No, the plugin is designed to preserve critical security and error notices to ensure your site remains secure.

Can I still update plugins and themes when notices are hidden?

Yes, the plugin only hides the visual notices. You can still update plugins and themes through the updates page.

Will I receive email notifications for failed updates?

If you enable “Hide Update Emails”, you will not receive any update notification emails, including for failed updates.
